findings.problem: bind(null) clears phaseFloors/deadlines and replaces scope with null. Real TopicGamesPanel passes null while connection is offline; reconnecting same identity/session/round resets again. Thus requested retention across transport loss fails despite direct transport-only unit control.
findings.reproduction: accept active invitation→clear→bind(null)→bind(same identity/session/round,transport2,rev4)→fresh valid pending projection same offer/proposal returns true. Direct transport change without null returns false.
findings.scope: Defense against phase regression, not evidence of server ACL bypass or actual secret leak. Candidate fixes original availability counterexample prospectively, but does not yet satisfy retention requirement.
findings.correction: Retain an immutable copy of last non-null room/member/identity/session/round reset anchor through null suspension. Null must still clear private values and invalidate generations; keep nonsecret floor/deadline history until next actual scope differs at a real reset boundary.
